Container.Name: copilot-cli
Container.Overview: GitHub Copilot CLI and GitHub CLI in a persistent Alpine Linux browser terminal.
Container.Description:
A browser terminal for GitHub Copilot CLI and GitHub CLI, backed by persistent Alpine Linux storage.
Set a strong web terminal password, then open the WebUI. The terminal supports colors, copy/paste, and interactive applications. Map /config to Appdata. GitHub and Copilot credentials, configuration, caches, and packages installed with `apk add` persist there. Map /workspace to the projects you want to edit. The terminal runs as root inside the container; do not expose it directly to the internet.

Config.Name: Persistent configuration
Config.Description: Stores authentication, settings, cache, and packages installed with apk.

Config.Name: Project workspace
Config.Description: Project files to work on. Only mount directories you want this terminal to access.

Config.Name: Web terminal username
Config.Description: HTTP basic-auth username for the browser terminal.

Config.Name: Web terminal password
Config.Description: Required HTTP basic-auth password for the browser terminal.
